summary:
I've been building and refining a SaaS crypto algo trading platform with AI and neural network components, focusing on wallet-group management, LLM-based judge systems, copy trading, and rebalancing strategies. The work spans new feature development, bugfixing, performance optimization, and documentation across the entire platform.

Alongside the trading platform, I've developed firmware for ESP32-S3-based mouse and keyboard emulation, a Windows input filter driver, and an Android TTS engine with multiple model support. These projects involve low-level hardware interaction, driver development, and mobile app engineering.

I've also worked on an agentic worker system in Rust, a computer vision project for poker platforms, a file-tagging utility for Windows Explorer, a browser-in-browser project, and an on-device LLM Android app. The work includes research in crypto price prediction models, trading strategy development, and various automation and tooling projects.

items.title: Agentic worker system development
items.description: Built LAN discovery, speech integration, and mesh networking for the agentic worker system, along with lifecycle management and security review fixes.

items.title: YOLO labeling tool updates
items.description: Added validator, constraint highlighting, and UI improvements to the YOLO labeling tool.

items.title: Summit wallet-group and auth fixes
items.description: Fixed wallet-group resize proposals and session persistence, and optimized the scanner to skip already-evaluated lanes.

items.title: Summit LLM judge system and copy trading
items.description: Implemented a System One judge seat for quorum and sentiment, provider capabilities for seat placement, and fixed copy trading floor and cap logic. Also added backtest configurator and admin features.

items.title: Intag2 file-tagging updates
items.description: Added Matroska and WebP tag writing, user zoom level, and DPI-aware UI scaling to the Windows Explorer file-tagging utility.

items.title: Sunflower browser-in-browser fixes
items.description: Fixed font pack building, container adoption, and proxy password handling for the browser-in-browser project.

items.title: Crypto model research audit
items.description: Conducted an audit of the crypto price prediction model, cataloging distinct models and refining the unified stack protocol.

items.title: Summit rebalancing and follows features
items.description: Added calm-liquidity basket as a paper-only signal, implemented trailing slider for follows, and fixed rebalancing and wallet-group veto logic.

items.title: Sunflower human input and deployment
items.description: Implemented human-like movement planning, permission prompt handling, and deployment improvements for the browser-in-browser project.

items.title: Crypto model research refit runbook
items.description: Developed a refit runbook, drift monitor, and validation response package for the crypto price prediction model.

items.title: Intag2 settings and Explorer refresh fixes
items.description: Fixed settings persistence, Explorer refresh, and backdrop fallback for the file-tagging utility.

items.title: Trading strategy development
items.description: Added multiple pack-relative and BTC-relative reversion strategies, along with EWO dip-buy variants for the trading bot.

items.title: Intag2 metadata writing and CI fixes
items.description: Added Vorbis comment writing for Ogg files and fixed metadata write error handling and uninstall path issues.

items.title: CV automation and profile updates
items.description: Reworked the CV generation pipeline with importance tags, split role descriptions, and added project cards with pulse charts.

items.title: Jolt hotkey automation tool
items.description: Built a minimal AutoHotKey alternative with interception support, conditions, rules, and sound actions.

items.title: Input driver library and integration tests
items.description: Added push-style event delivery, integration test runner, and per-event blocking to the Windows input filter driver.

items.title: Android TTS engine development
items.description: Integrated multiple TTS models including F5-TTS, GPT-SoVITS, and Piper, added pitch control, and improved text normalization.

items.title: USB HID firmware updates
items.description: Added fire-and-forget emitting and 8x8 matrix variant to the ESP32-S3 firmware.

items.title: MEMU3 YOLO and bow/flick features
items.description: Switched GPU inference to DirectML, added bow/flick tracking with bezier motion, and improved YOLO confidence threshold UI.

items.title: USB HID firmware v13 draft
items.description: Drafted the v13 firmware variant with USB HID support and fixed dying/disconnect issues.

items.title: Papyrix e-ink firmware features
items.description: Added map app, knowledge base, FB2 encoding fixes, and optimized map renderer for Apple Silicon.

items.title: FlClash proxy support
items.description: Added XHTTP transport support via rebased mihomo fork.

items.title: Ozwil Android LLM app development
items.description: Rewrote sub-agent architecture with session-based delegation, added tool routing strategies, and integrated multiple offline models.

items.title: MEMU3 overlay and mode persistence
items.description: Rewrote overlay to D3D11+D2D+DComp, added linger mode and autofire, and persisted mode state across restarts.

items.title: Blackboard launcher for E-ink
items.description: Built a note-centric Android launcher for E-ink devices with swipe navigation and status bar control.

items.title: Intag2 CI and Store publishing fixes
items.description: Fixed Microsoft Store publishing pipeline with PowerShell REST API and resolved Partner Center API errors.

items.title: Jaxon code intelligence engine
items.description: Added LSP integration, dead code detection, and multi-language parser support for the code intelligence engine.

items.title: n8n TelePilot2 node fixes
items.description: Fixed auth race conditions and CI test issues for the n8n Telegram node fork.

items.title: Dotfiles and Neovim config

items.title: Poker CV pipeline development

items.title: USB HID firmware v11-v12

items.title: Tasker app improvements

items.title: Telegram bot development

items.title: Telegram bot maintenance
items.description: Maintained the Telegram automation bot with logging improvements and forwarding fixes.
